sloka: तत्र त्रयोदशे वर्षे राज्येनेक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम् ।अभिषेचयितुं राजा सोपाध्यायः प्रचक्रमे ।। ५.३३.१९।।।।
transliteration: tatra trayodaśe varṣe rājyenekṣvākunandanam ।abhiṣecayituṁ rājā sopādhyāyaḥ pracakrame ।। 5.33.19।।।।

translations.english: "While preparations for the coronation were on, queen Kaikeyi said to her husband:
